task.description:
Validate that EE-11 (State reconstruction) is ready for release.

1. Read tests/reports/EE-11-test-report.md. Confirm all tests PASSED.
2. Confirm NFR-04 timing result is ≤ 5 seconds for 10,000 events.
3. Run `zig build` and `zig build test` and confirm both exit 0.
4. Confirm EE-11 acceptance criteria are all satisfied per the test report.
5. Write release decision to docs/status/release-EE11-20260522.json.

If any criterion fails, set result.status = FAIL with detailed issues.
acceptance_criteria: All EE-11 acceptance criteria confirmed satisfied
NFR-04 confirmed: reconstruction of 10,000-event instance ≤ 5 seconds
